title: Mob Get Attracted
description: This mods add several block to improving mob farm
body:
![the block that the mods add](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e03cb7fadb5cd5533bbae6727e0f673668158f23.png)

## **Mob Get Attracted**

This **mod adds two types of blocks**:

- **Blocks that attract mobs**
- **Blocks that filter/trap mobs**

This mod was made to **improve and simplify mob farm automation**.

### **Bonus Functionality**
You can **apply camouflage to the filter/trap blocks**, allowing you to keep a **clean and good-looking farm design**.

![logo of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55f95100db84d504f391435287e8ffabc0b6bc7c_0.webp)

### **Compatibility**
- **Compatible with JEI**
- **Works on servers**
